input.goal: Write three unit tests for my FastAPI login endpoint using the existing local test runner and fixtures.

effective_context.goal: Write three unit tests for my FastAPI login endpoint using the existing local test runner and fixtures.

quests.title: Identify the endpoint and fixtures
quests.action: Inspect the local FastAPI project, locate the login endpoint, and verify the fixtures used for testing.
quests.completion_criteria: The endpoint URL and fixture names are identified and confirmed to match the expected login endpoint.
quests.hint: Look for a route like `/login` in the project's `routes.py` or similar file.

quests.title: Write the first unit test
quests.action: Use the local test runner to write a unit test for the login endpoint, ensuring it mocks the necessary fixtures.
quests.completion_criteria: The first unit test is written and runs successfully, mocking the login endpoint and fixtures.
quests.hint: Use the `pytest` runner and ensure the test uses the correct fixture names.

quests.title: Write the second and third unit tests
quests.action: Write two additional unit tests for the login endpoint, ensuring they cover different scenarios (e.g., valid credentials, invalid credentials, unauthorized access).
quests.completion_criteria: All three unit tests are written, run successfully, and cover the required scenarios.
quests.hint: Use the local test runner and ensure each test uses the correct fixtures and mocks the login endpoint.
